changelog: THREE WAYS TO PLAY EVERY COMMANDER. Each commander now has three archetypes, and your card offers lean toward the one you are building, so a run can commit to a style and see it through. New DOCTRINE cards set a lasting rule for the rest of the battle: play one and it is exhausted, its effect stays, and a second copy of the same Doctrine stacks on the first. Twenty-four new cards fill out the thinner archetypes, all with new art, and cards that duplicated each other were reworked into something new rather than cut. A card-base pass retuned costs and rarities across the board. The Emplacement is ground artillery and can no longer hit flying Drones. Fights you win by lasting (Survive and Hold) no longer pair you with an enemy that stays home, so sitting still cannot win them. FIXES: the second battle in a row could open with your army stuck in reserve and no panel to place it from; a trip to the menu and back made it reappear. That is fixed. Small windows: the fog is seamless (no more grid lines or squares), the unit panel scales with the window instead of covering half of it, the map no longer slides under its legend, headers sit inside their frames, and the main menu tiles are a true even grid. The desktop main menu has a Quit button. Plus many smaller fixes from a full audit.
